title: Marius discusses his leg B

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Well I'll be honest, I didn't expect to see you again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I'll be honest, I didn't expect to see you again.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm tougher than I look.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm tougher than I look.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Everyone's tough until they wake up inside a deep fat fryer. That tends to make people go very crispy very quickly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Everyone's tough until they wake up inside a deep fat fryer. That tends to make people go very crispy very quickly.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Well the life expectancy of someone not paying protection is days in this town.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well the life expectancy of someone not paying protection is days in this town.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How have you survived?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How have you survived?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think you're just making this stuff up to extort me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you're just making this stuff up to extort me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think you're just making this stuff up to extort me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think you're just making this stuff up to extort me.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Look at me... notice anything strange? Anything off to you limb-wise? have a look in the leg area?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look at me... notice anything strange? Anything off to you limb-wise? have a look in the leg area?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You have one leg?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have one leg?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: You think I lost it behind the sofa? Left it in the back of a taxi? Fuck no, this was Aengus Prince.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think I lost it behind the sofa? Left it in the back of a taxi? Fuck no, this was Aengus Prince.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Aengus Prince took your leg?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aengus Prince took your leg?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Well no, I lent it to him and he never gave it back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well no, I lent it to him and he never gave it back.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Looks fine to me...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Looks fine to me...

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: No look, I only have one real leg...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No look, I only have one real leg...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I didn't want to make a point out of it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't want to make a point out of it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I didn't want to make a point out of it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I didn't want to make a point out of it.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Well... that's very kind... but I'm trying to make a point out of it. What do you think happened to it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... that's very kind... but I'm trying to make a point out of it. What do you think happened to it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm all ears.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm all ears.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why would you lend someone your leg? That's insane.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why would you lend someone your leg? That's insane.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why would you lend someone your leg? That's insane.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why would you lend someone your leg? That's insane.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What did he do with it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What did he do with it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What did he do with it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What did he do with it?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: What do you think he did with it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you think he did with it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...Ate it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Ate it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sold it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sold it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Recycled it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Recycled it?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Aengus is the best in the business, it was a peace offering in exchange for tutorship. I heard he was on the lookout for bits of body and I offered mine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aengus is the best in the business, it was a peace offering in exchange for tutorship. I heard he was on the lookout for bits of body and I offered mine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What did he do with it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What did he do with it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What did he do with it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What did he do with it?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: You're sick, you know that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're sick, you know that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Look I don't really know what your point is here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look I don't really know what your point is here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Look I don't really know what your point is here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Look I don't really know what your point is here.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: The point, Little Berry Mouse, is if you keep scraping the glaze as closely as you are, you're gonna lose your own limbs soon enough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The point, Little Berry Mouse, is if you keep scraping the glaze as closely as you are, you're gonna lose your own limbs soon enough.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If anyone asks to borrow my limbs I'll just say no.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If anyone asks to borrow my limbs I'll just say no.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If anyone asks to borrow my limbs I'll just say no.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If anyone asks to borrow my limbs I'll just say no.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I see your point.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see your point.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: See this as an investment into your future. Lims for Limbs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See this as an investment into your future. Lims for Limbs.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Ok, two moves ahead I see. Well you'd better hope it's enough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok, two moves ahead I see. Well you'd better hope it's enough.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine! How much?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine! How much?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Shall we say a square 95 Lims?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Shall we say a square 95 Lims?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure, here you go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, here you go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No thanks, this is extortion.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No thanks, this is extortion.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Ok ok ok fine. Maybe instead we could work something else out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok ok ok fine. Maybe instead we could work something else out?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Oh one more thing. Remember what I said about Aengus Prince?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh one more thing. Remember what I said about Aengus Prince?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: You remember a few moments ago, I was talking about my leg and Aengus Prince?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You remember a few moments ago, I was talking about my leg and Aengus Prince?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How could I forget?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How could I forget?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Well the thing is, there's a rumor he's using it for some sick... I don't know but I've heard he's using it for something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well the thing is, there's a rumor he's using it for some sick... I don't know but I've heard he's using it for something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right...?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: I just wondered if you'd mind speaking to him for me? See if you can find out where he might be keeping it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just wondered if you'd mind speaking to him for me? See if you can find out where he might be keeping it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why can't you do it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why can't you do it?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Picture the scene: You're minding your own business, all is well.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Picture the scene: You're minding your own business, all is well.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So he'll leg it when you approach him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So he'll leg it when you approach him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So he'll leg it when you approach him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So he'll leg it when you approach him?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Firstly, poor choice of words. Secondly I have no idea as I've never tried but that's what I'd do! Look, do it for me and I'll give you free protection for life!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Firstly, poor choice of words. Secondly I have no idea as I've never tried but that's what I'd do! Look, do it for me and I'll give you free protection for life!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do it yourself!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do it yourself!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think it will be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think it will be.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can I get a refund on the other payments?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I get a refund on the other payments?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can I get a refund on the other payments?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can I get a refund on the other payments?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Maybe...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: I'm many things, but I ain't a liar.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm many things, but I ain't a liar.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: HOVA accident?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: HOVA accident?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Good idea, but no.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good idea, but no.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened then?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Wait, who's that walking towards you? "Oh my, it's the guy who's leg I stole all those years ago! I'd better split!"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, who's that walking towards you? "Oh my, it's the guy who's leg I stole all those years ago! I'd better split!"
